issue.title: Load gauge 'Held by' tooltip labels every holder as a workflow step (checkout/diff)

task_type_fields.impact: Every user hovering the Agents load gauge sees holders named checkout/diff, so the one capacity explanation surface cannot identify which agents occupy the machine; research report research:202610/machine_load_accounting_transparency/machine_load_accounting_transparency__final.md (C5).
task_type_fields.repro:
Read-only repro on athena (2026-10-26, sase f4591e9106, installed tool interpreter):

```python
from sase.config.core import get_max_running_agents
from sase.ace.tui.models.agent_loader import load_tiered_agents
from sase.ace.tui.models.agent_runner_slots import refresh_runner_slot_context
agents, _ = load_tiered_agents(full_history=True)
ctx = refresh_runner_slot_context(agents, effective_limit=get_max_running_agents())
for h in ctx.holders: print(h)
```

All 10 live holders printed as `RunnerCapacityHolder(label='checkout', ...)` or
`label='diff'`, never an agent name. Root cause: `_apply_runner_capacity_snapshot` builds
`source_agent_by_artifact_dir = {capacity_artifact_dir(a): a for a in capacity_agents}`
(and the matching `display_agent_by_artifact_dir`) as a last-wins dict comprehension.
Workflow step child rows (`setup`, `prepare`, `checkout`, `main`, `diff`) share the
agent's `artifacts_dir`, so they overwrite the agent row, and `_capacity_holders` labels
the claim with the step row's `cl_name`. Introduced with the holder tooltip in
9fc571b221. Fix: skip `is_workflow_child` rows when indexing (or prefer rows with an
`agent_name`/`appears_as_agent`), and add a regression test where step rows share the
artifact dir.

issue.creation_reason: Found while researching why athena's load gauge read 3/8 with 6 running; the tooltip is the only in-product explanation of capacity holders and currently names no agent.

payload.close_reason: Fixed by cef4bb1199 (sase-1om.1, 2026-10-26): roster artifact-dir maps skip workflow-step children, so workflow steps no longer replace holder labels; regressions were added.
